items.information: # Note: This is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Only competition. Welcome to Malaysia FMC Championship 2025! As FMC is not being held at [Malaysia Cube Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaCubeChampionship2025), this is your chance to become the Malaysia's Fewest Moves Champion! The competition will be held in Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru and Penang. Please check select the [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2025#66171-location) you wish to join FMC when you make the payment. **3x3x3 Fewest Moves event** (**this may not be recommended for new competitor**). For those who are interested in joining **Please Be Quiet Kuala Lumpur 2025** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKualaLumpur2025) / **Please Be Quiet Johor 2025** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietJohor2025). The event will take place at the same venue before this competition. #### After the completion of your registration, please send us an email regarding which location that you wish to join, so we can estimate the turnout for each location. [![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2025)

items.name: Quiet Seattle November 2025

venue.name: University of Washington, Spratlen Hall 311
venue.address: 4320 Little Canoe Channel NE, Seattle, WA 98195
venue.details: Enter through the South corner. Room 311 is on the ground floor. Spratlen Hall was recently renamed and may show up as Madrona Hall (the old name) on maps.

items.information: This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome to sign up. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=US&search=Washington).
